local_review.finding_body: The new Jetty 10 test project used 2-second waits for asynchronous I/O callbacks and a 100-millisecond IdleTimeout. These explicit I/O timeouts violated FS-test-contract.1.7, which requires at least 10 seconds to avoid agent and Native Image startup flakiness.
local_review.finding_title: Jetty I/O tests used explicit timeouts below the required floor
local_review.fix_note: Raised the asynchronous write and callback waits to 10 seconds, configured IdleTimeout to 10 seconds, and allowed 30 seconds for its expiration assertion. The repaired tests remain individually bounded below 60 seconds and passed the authoritative finalization run.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the complete contribution diff and the fixes-javac-fail rules. The change is confined to org.eclipse.jetty:jetty-io:10.0.0, narrowly ports the existing suite to the Jetty 10 API, preserves meaningful assertions and Native Image execution, uses only reachability-metadata.json, and keeps both overall and reflection dynamic-access coverage at 1/1 (100%) versus 1/1 (100%) for 9.4.47.v20220610. The recorded index gates passed. After the timeout repair, the exact Forge finalization command passed all three test lanes and completed metadata splitting/validation, style checks, generated-test validation, and regenerated-stat checks without further publishable changes.
